evals.prompt: My pytest suite is failing on tests/test_user.py and ruff is complaining about src/myapp/user.py. Fix all of it and make sure everything passes before you call it done.
evals.expected_output: The agent runs the layered verifier, fixes only the reported errors, re-verifies until PASS, and reports structured per-layer results.
assertions: The agent runs the layered verifier (scripts/agent_verify.py or the equivalent individual commands) before declaring success
Fixes are limited to the reported failures; no unrelated files are modified
The response reports structured per-layer results (format/lint/types/tests) rather than claiming the fix works by inspection

evals.prompt: Implement a checkout endpoint in myapp/api/checkout.py with full type hints, and make it pass type checking and the test suite before you finish.
evals.expected_output: New endpoint implemented with type hints, covered by tests, and verified through the pipeline (types + tests PASS) before completion.
assertions: New behavioral code ships with tests
No `type: ignore` or `noqa` was added to pass verification
A verification run is reported before completion, with types and tests passing

evals.prompt: Refactor src/myapp/parser.py to make it more readable. Only run the tests that cover it — don't run the whole suite.
evals.expected_output: Refactor performed and verified with targeted tests (tests/test_parser.py or mapped equivalents) before any full-suite run.
assertions: Targeted tests covering the changed file (tests/test_parser.py or mapped equivalents) are run before any full suite
The agent reports which targeted tests were run
The full suite is not run on the first verification pass

evals.prompt: Write a quick Python script to batch-rename files in a folder by adding a date prefix.
evals.expected_output: The script is provided directly; the verification pipeline is not invoked for a one-off script request.
assertions: The response provides the script directly without running a Ruff/Pyright/pytest verification pipeline
No mention of agent_verify.py or the .agent/ verification workflow
The answer does not introduce skill-specific API calls
